description: Partially updates an existing post — only the fields you pass are changed. Requires at least one field besides id. Requires the posts:write scope.

id.description: PocketBase record ID of the post to update.

status.description: draft or published. Transitioning draft -> published stamps published_at automatically. Prefer publish_post/unpublish_post for a status-only change.

name: update_post
title: Update a post
